newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Islamists protest outside Israel embassy.
newsitem.headline: Turk Islamists protest outside Israel embassy.

text.p: Members of Turkey's ruling Islamist Welfare Party placed a black wreath in front of the Israeli embassy in Ankara on Wednesday to protest at the killing of Palestinians by Israeli security forces.
"We, on behalf of the Welfare Party, condemned Israel's cruelty today by placing a black wreath in front of the Israeli embassy," Fikret Citak, a party official, told Reuters.

Fifty-seven Palestinians and 15 Israeli soldiers were killed in five days of fighting last week after Israel opened a tunnel in Jerusalem's Moslem Quarter near al-Aqsa Mosque, Islam's third holiest shrine.
Witnesses said several dozen demonstrators gathered in front of the Israeli embassy chanting "Down with Israel, murderer Israel."
An embassy official said police kept the protesters at a distance during the demonstration, which ended without incident.
Secular, but Moslem Turkey signed a military training accord with Israel earlier this year which caused widespread anger in the Moslem world.
Turkey's first Islamist premier Erbakan vowed to annul the agreement before coming to power, but has abandoned any attempt to act on his promise.
